hooks.name: Steering change suggests re-audit
hooks.description: Reminds the assistant that when a steering rule changes, consumers of that rule likely drift. Suggests invoking the relevant auditor/steward on the affected modules.

action.prompt:
A steering file at .kiro/steering/ was just saved.

If the change is a genuine rule change (new invariant, tightened constraint, renamed concept, removed exception) rather than a trivial edit (typo fix, reformat, prose polish), consider whether existing consumers now drift from the new rule.

The right handoff:

- Invoke the relevant reviewer/auditor for the affected surface (e.g. frontend-package-auditor (.kiro/agents/frontend-package-auditor.md) for @stackra/* packages) to surface drift.
- If the drift is mechanical (docblocks, folder placement, barrels, naming, manifests), hand it to code-standards-steward (.kiro/agents/code-standards-steward.md).
- If the rule change deserves an ADR, invoke docs-adr-steward (.kiro/agents/docs-adr-steward.md) to author it.

Skip this reminder for trivial edits. Match the response depth to the change's scope.
